---
name: Feature or adoption request
description: Propose capability justified by a concrete merchant, pilot, integration, or production need
title: "feat: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Merchant / adopter problem

Describe the observed problem or opportunity. Who needs this, and in what operating context?

## Evidence / demand signal

What concrete input supports doing this now (pilot feedback, adopter request, integration requirement, production constraint, repeated workflow friction, or other evidence)? Link or quote evidence where possible.

## Desired outcome

Describe the outcome to achieve rather than prescribing an implementation.

## Why this belongs in KiranaOS

Explain how the request advances the project's merchant operating model and why it should live in this repository.

## Scope and authority boundary

What actors may initiate, approve, modify, or revoke the proposed behavior? Identify any payment, accounting, customer-data, staff, AI, or external-system authority implications.

## Safety, privacy, security, and compatibility considerations

Identify material risks, migration concerns, new trust boundaries, or compatibility effects. Write `none identified` only after considering them.

## MVP / smallest useful slice

What is the smallest coherent implementation that would test whether this request is useful?

## Acceptance evidence

What observable or executable evidence would show that the request is successfully implemented? Include negative cases where relevant.

## Alternatives / workarounds

How is the need handled today, and why is that insufficient?

## Roadmap promotion

Submitting this issue does **not** create a roadmap commitment. A request may be promoted into a future roadmap tranche when the demand signal is credible, the scope and authority boundaries are understood, the smallest useful slice is testable, and implementation cost/risk is proportionate to expected adoption value.
